decisions.reason: As a recent launch with its own webpage and a clear extension of the firm’s established energy-data and calculation offer, management is likely to stay committed and explain any early weakness as temporary.
Because it is close to the core offer and was publicly presented on its own page, the firm has enough strategic and reputational commitment to continue rather than withdraw it quickly.
Its strong fit with the firm’s tariff and market-process solutions and its visible standalone presentation make continued support more likely than an early discontinuation.

Although it appears less heavily promoted because it was only mentioned on the website, it still builds on the established offer and fits the firm’s platform-expansion path, which supports persistence.
This product both builds on existing capabilities and received a dedicated webpage, so prior investment and public commitment make management likely to retain it.

This is the most vulnerable of the group because it was only mentioned on the website and seems somewhat less central, but its closeness to the core business and the recency of launch still favor keeping it for now.
